reading: Lotte Underwood has finished university and uses AI tools for much of her work.
Her team's AI tools are computer programs that help with tasks like research and making pictures.
She checks their work and shares it with other people in her team.
She also joins meetings to learn how these tools can help customers.
Underwood wants to learn other skills for her job too.
Patel builds AI tools that give information to different teams.
Patel also looks for tasks that AI could do, such as work that people repeat.
Some graduates work with experienced staff to learn their jobs.
They move to a different area of work every six months.
Claire Reed believes too much AI work may not help graduates build their future careers.
She says workers need AI skills and knowledge of what their customers want.

vocabulary.definition: Pieces of work that someone needs to do.
Looks at something to see if it is correct.
Gives something to other people so they can use it too.
Times when people come together to talk about something.
Things you can do well because you have learned or practised them.
The people who work for a company.

entries.ja: 誰かがする必要のある、一つ一つの仕事です。
entries.zh-Hans: 某人需要做的一项项工作。
entries.es: Trabajos concretos que alguien necesita hacer.
entries.pt-BR: Trabalhos específicos que alguém precisa fazer.
entries.fr: Différents travaux qu’une personne doit faire.
entries.de: Einzelne Arbeiten, die jemand erledigen muss.

entries.ja: 何かが正しいかどうかを確かめるために、それを見ます。
entries.zh-Hans: 查看某样东西，确认它是否正确。
entries.es: Examina algo para ver si es correcto.
entries.pt-BR: Examina algo para ver se está correto.
entries.fr: Examine quelque chose pour voir si c’est correct.
entries.de: Sieht sich etwas an, um festzustellen, ob es richtig ist.

entries.ja: ほかの人も使えるように、その人たちに何かを渡します。

entries.zh-Hans: 把某样东西给其他人，让他们也能使用。
entries.es: Da algo a otras personas para que también puedan usarlo.
entries.pt-BR: Dá algo a outras pessoas para que elas também possam usar.
entries.fr: Donne quelque chose à d’autres personnes pour qu’elles puissent aussi l’utiliser.
entries.de: Gibt anderen Menschen etwas, damit sie es auch benutzen können.

entries.ja: 何かについて話すために、人々が集まる機会です。
entries.ko: 사람들이 무언가에 대해 이야기하려고 모이는 시간입니다.
entries.zh-Hans: 人们聚在一起讨论某件事的时候。
entries.es: Ocasiones en las que las personas se reúnen para hablar de algo.
entries.pt-BR: Momentos em que as pessoas se reúnem para conversar sobre algo.
entries.fr: Moments où des personnes se réunissent pour parler de quelque chose.
entries.de: Gelegenheiten, bei denen Menschen zusammenkommen, um über etwas zu sprechen.

entries.ja: 学んだり練習したりしたことで、上手にできることです。
entries.ko: 배우거나 연습해서 잘할 수 있는 것들입니다.
entries.zh-Hans: 通过学习或练习而能做好的事情。
entries.es: Cosas que puedes hacer bien porque las has aprendido o practicado.
entries.pt-BR: Coisas que você consegue fazer bem porque aprendeu ou praticou.
entries.fr: Choses que l’on sait bien faire parce qu’on les a apprises ou pratiquées.
entries.de: Dinge, die man gut kann, weil man sie gelernt oder geübt hat.

entries.ja: 会社で働く人たちです。
entries.zh-Hans: 为一家公司工作的人们。
entries.es: Las personas que trabajan para una empresa.
entries.pt-BR: As pessoas que trabalham para uma empresa.
entries.fr: Les personnes qui travaillent pour une entreprise.
entries.de: Die Menschen, die für ein Unternehmen arbeiten.
